name: Nijihara Mizuki
source: MC childhood friend, who is in the same school as him. She is bright, fearless and energetic, but on the other hand she has a mannish and ill mannered personality. Her appearance is also stylish and she has beautiful figure and face, but she isn't really self conscious as a girl.
